title: Three-foot object with buttons lying on Mars

tellings.quote: that's 3 feet long and that big around that's and it's got buttons on it

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a man who says he did psychic "remote viewing" work for the US military, describes an object on Mars about three feet long with buttons on it. He links it to photo negatives from the Mars mapping done by JPL, the NASA laboratory that runs many space missions. If true, it would suggest something built by intelligent beings once sat on Mars.
